title: What If Prices Dropped Every Minute You Waited?

finale.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if prices dropped *every minute* you waited?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay just inherited his grandma's toy shop. *Penny's*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: It's tiny. It's dusty. And it's *empty*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Rent is due Monday. *Nine thousand* dollars.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, I have *two hundred* dollars.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Then we need Black Friday. And a *crazy idea*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Boston, nineteen oh nine. A store with *falling prices*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Unsold after twelve days? Twenty five percent *off*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Still unsold? It went to *charity*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Days are too slow. What about... *minutes*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: So they invent *the Drop*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia, his best friend, prints *five hundred* flyers.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Black Friday. Six a.m. Prices fall *till midnight*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Friday morning, the line wraps around the *block*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Six o'clock. The doors open. The clock *starts*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every price tag in the store starts *falling*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Okay, everyone. Go! *Buy things*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But nobody moves. Not *one* person.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay... they're not shopping. They're *waiting*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two. Prices are falling. Nobody is *buying*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Seven a.m. Everything is ten percent *off*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nine a.m. Thirty percent. Still *nothing*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, why is nobody *buying*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It's a *Dutch auction*. You built one by accident.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Price starts high. Falls until someone *says yes*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Dutch flower markets sell flowers with a *falling clock*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Wait too long, and someone else *takes it*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In the corner, a kid stares at a *robot*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: I'm Theo. My sister turns seven *on Sunday*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The robot costs forty dollars. Theo has *twelve*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: At this speed, it hits twelve at *two p.m.*

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Then I'll wait. I'm *very* good at waiting.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia picks up the ugliest sweater in the *shop*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Forty bucks? Hmm. *Not yet*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: By the door, a man in sunglasses *smiles*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. That man has been inside *since midnight*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: We opened at six. How is that *possible*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Not in the store. In our *website*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three. A stranger is hiding in *our website*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: His name is Flip. He flips toys *for money*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: I buy low. I sell high. It's called *business*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: His bot has four hundred toys *in its cart*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Every toy in the shop? At *what price*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The lowest price the Drop allows. *One cent*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Four hundred toys for four dollars? Stop *the Drop*!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay, five hundred flyers said *until midnight*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay looks at the crowd. They look *back*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: If I stop now, they'll tear it *apart*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Relax, kid. I'm a *patient* man.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Noon. Prices are sixty percent off. Still *no sales*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The robot toy falls to *sixteen dollars*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Sixteen. Almost. I have twelve. *Almost*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia checks her sweater. Twenty dollars. *Not yet*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. Flip's bot just picked *the robot*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Theo. The bot wants your robot. Buy it *now*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: I only have twelve. I *can't*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Somewhere, a computer counts down to *one cent*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four. Flip's bot waits for *one cent*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Two p.m. The robot hits *twelve dollars*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Twelve! I have twelve! I'm *buying* it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Theo runs to the counter. His coins *spill*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: He counts. Ten. Eleven. One coin is *missing*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, can't we just give him *one dollar*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The Drop is automatic. Three. Two. *One*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three p.m. Every price hits *one cent*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In one second, Flip's bot buys *everything*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The robot. The puzzles. Even Mia's *ugly sweater*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: It was going to be *ten bucks*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The crowd shuffles out. The shop is *silent*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Total sales today. Four dollars. And *zero cents*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Theo stands at the counter. *Eleven dollars* in hand.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: It's okay. Robots are for *babies* anyway.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Theo, wait. I'm *so* sorry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The door chimes. Flip walks out *whistling*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Thanks for the sale. Want them back? *Triple price*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five. Flip bought everything for *four dollars*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Five p.m. Flip's toys are *online*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: A hundred twenty dollars. For *Theo's* robot.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: And my sweater. Ninety *nine* dollars!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay drops into Grandma's old chair. Something *crinkles*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A shoebox. Old price tags. And a *note*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Two people. Today I made *one*. Flip.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. Can I read the flyer *again*?

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: I made those flyers. They're *perfect*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Tiny print, bottom corner. Mia, did you *write* this?

ui.sub: by midnight, or the order is cancelled

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Grandma Penny's rule. I copied it from *her sign*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Flip's four hundred toys are still on *our shelf*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: He has to come and get them. *Before midnight*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: And his bot used four hundred *accounts*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Flip's phone buzzes. *Pickup reminder*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Pickup? Who reads the *fine print*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Eleven p.m. A rumble outside the *shop*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Flip is back. A truck. And *four hundred people*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six. Flip came back with *four hundred* people.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Four hundred orders. Four hundred people. *Pay up*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit... can he *do* that?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Every order needs the account holder's *ID*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The first stranger steps up. Jay checks the *name*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Order one. Name on the account... *F. Lipp*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Order two. *F. Lipp*. Order three. *F. Lipp*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: All four hundred accounts. *Same name*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: And only one F. Lipp is *standing here*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The hired crowd shrugs and walks *home*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Fine! One item. I take the *robot*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Midnight. Three hundred ninety nine orders *cancelled*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Flip walks out with one robot. For *one cent*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay sits alone among three hundred ninety nine *toys*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: I saved the toys. But I lost *Theo's* robot.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Grandma Penny would have hated the *Drop*, wouldn't she?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: No. She'd hate that *nobody* won.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. Tomorrow we run it again. *One change*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay writes it on a card in Grandma's *handwriting*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven. The Drop runs again. *One of each*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Saturday, six a.m. The crowd is *back*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: New rule. Every toy is the *only one*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The prices start falling. And *this time*...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: a man grabs a train set at *thirty dollars*.

lines.speaker: soldier
lines.say: I'm not risking it. My son *loves* trains.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Falling clock rule. Whoever wants it most *buys first*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Puzzles. Dolls. Kites. One by one, *everything* sells.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia guards her sweater. Twenty dollars. *Still not yet*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the door opens. It's *Theo*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Behind him, Flip. With the robot. *A hundred twenty*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Kid followed me for blocks. Market price. *Take it*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Flip. What did you pay for that? *One cent*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: I'll buy it back. Forty dollars. *Original price*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Forty times four thousand. Deal, *sucker*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay gives Theo the robot. Theo pays *eleven dollars*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Closing time. Jay counts the *register*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Eight thousand nine hundred sixty. We're short *forty dollars*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The final part drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part eight. The shop is short exactly *forty dollars*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Forty dollars. The price of *one robot*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Rent is due Monday. Nothing is left *to sell*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Well... *almost* nothing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On the last rack, the ugly sweater. *One cent*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: One cent. I finally *won*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia takes it. And slaps down *forty dollars*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Mia, the price is *one cent*!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Fair price. It makes *two* people happy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nine thousand dollars. The rent is *paid*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Sunday, a photo arrives. Theo's sister. And a *robot*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And Flip? His toys are gone. *Zero sales*.

lines.speaker: gambler
lines.say: Who pays triple when the Drop is *next door*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Monday morning. One last item in the *sale bin*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: It's Bit. With a price tag on his *head*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: One million dollars. Falling every minute. *Act fast*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, get out. You're *not for sale*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Correct. I'm *priceless*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
